  exprs=(

    "1 as \$$k | { \$$k }"
    "1 as \$$k | { \$$k: . }"
    "1 as \$$k | { (\$$k): . }"

    "{a:1} as {\"a\": \$$k} | \$$k"
    "def f(\$$k): \$$k; 1|f(.)"
    "label \$$k | (1, break \$$k)"
    "[label \$$k | range(5) | ., (select(. == 2) | break \$$k)]"
    "reduce .[] as \$$k (0; . + \$$k)"
    "[foreach .[] as \$$k (0; . + \$$k; .)]"
  )
  i=0
  for e in "${exprs[@]}"; do
    i=$((i+1))
    out=$(printf 'null\n[1,2,3]\n' | ./jq -c -n "$e" 2>&1)
    rc=$?
    if [ $rc -ne 0 ]; then
      echo "FAIL kw=$k case=$i expr=$e :: $out"
      fail=1
    fi
  done
done
# foreach needs input iterating, test separately
for k in $kws; do
  [ "$k" = "__loc__" ] && continue
  out=$(printf '[1,2,3]\n' | ./jq -c "[foreach .[] as \$$k (0; . + \$$k; .)]" 2>&1)

done
[ $fail -eq 0 ] && echo "ALL OK"
